_comment: Published identifiers for the Cipher Museum software and the Cipher Corpus datasets. This is the single source of truth: scripts/validate-release-metadata.js reads it instead of hard-coding DOIs, and scripts/record-dataset-doi.js adds a dataset entry once Zenodo issues its DOI. A dataset may only appear here with a real, issued DOI.
_rule: Never add an entry for a version that has not been deposited. An unpublished dataset belongs in `pending`, with no DOI, until Zenodo issues one.

software.title: Cipher Museum: An Interactive History of Cryptography and Codebreaking
software.author: Clark, Paul A.

datasets.notes: The archive the repository serves and the software v1.0.0 record supplements. Its bytes, checksums and schema are frozen; corrections are carried as errata in docs/CORPUS-V06-ERRATA.md.

pending.status: tagged; no Zenodo deposit and no DOI issued
pending.blocked_on: A Zenodo deposit must be created under dataset_concept_doi by someone holding credentials for that Zenodo account. Build the canonical bytes with `npm run build:corpus:v07` and verify them against public/corpus/v0.7/SHA256SUMS.txt before uploading.
pending.on_issue: Run `node scripts/record-dataset-doi.js 0.7 <issued-doi>` to move this entry into `datasets` and update every citation surface at once.
